scope: 십자 참격 cell-band and single-sword corrective regeneration
commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production 2D combat VFX spritesheet with exactly 16 chronological frames in a strict 4-column by 4-row row-major layout. Each sealed cell is exactly 361x160; final sheet exactly 1444x640, Detailed high-resolution Korean fantasy action-RPG painting, clean transparent RGBA, image-rendering auto, not pixel art. This is a corrective regeneration from scratch. The rejected sheet is diagnosis only and must not be imitated. F01-F04 must contain zero visible pixels and zero glow. F05 contains one tiny narrow steel glint only at x=28%,y=64%. F06-F09 prepare ONE connected sword. F10-F12 perform two quick sequential strokes with only one full sword per frame. F13 is first physical contact, F14 compression, F15 the unique maximum cross fracture, F16 holds the same final contact for the web renderer. F16 is not a fade. Treat every cell as a completely sealed final image. Keep every visible pixel inside x=24..337 and y=18..138. The top 12px and bottom 18px of every cell must be exactly transparent. No frame may contain a partial sword, light streak, spark, fragment, shadow, reflection or image band along its top or bottom. Never borrow pixels from the cell above, below, left or right. One fixed camera and one immutable sword design; no redraw wobble or reverse motion.

skills.generationPrompt: Regenerate 십자 참격 from scratch using SEALED_OFFSET_TWO_STROKE_CROSS_CUT. Draw one plain single-edged steel battlefield sword with one connected dark grip, compact crossguard and pommel. Maintain identical proportions and a fixed three-quarter view. First stroke path L1 runs from (31%,68%) to (67%,31%). Second stroke path L2 runs from (36%,30%) to final contact P=(65%,66%). The two lines cross off-center at (53%,49%) and are unequal, never a symmetrical X. F05 tiny glint only. F06-F09 show the one sword preparing near the L1 start with no long wake. F10 completes L1, leaving one thin pale-blue wake. F11 relocates the same single sword to the L2 start; F12 travels 80% down L2. F13 is first physical contact at P with one tiny ivory notch. F14 compresses the L2 edge and first wake together. F15 completes one compact asymmetric cross fracture: the visible sword stays at P, L1 remains a subordinate thin wake, L2 is the dominant ivory steel cut, with four small gunmetal chips and three amber sparks. F16 holds the same sword and fracture at 80% energy. Fit the entire effect in the inner safe rectangle and keep the lower 18 pixels empty. No curved crescent arcs, duplicate weapons, early contact, giant star, explosion, ring or bottom residue.
